messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sample app is spiking 429s for new orgs. Saw a huge burst of parallel embed/generation calls right at startup.
kevin: Reproable locally or only in hosted?
maria: Repro locally against staging endpoint. Steps: create org, run sampleapp, it prefetches embeddings for seed docs then launches demo queries. On hosted we see ~20-30% 429s for the first 45-60s.
uli: Do we know if it's quota exhaustion or rate-limiter queuing? Any logs?
maria: Logs show a token refresh race + immediate retries. Also sampleapp launches a prefetch loop with concurrency ~64 (old default) so it essentially floods the client-side with inflight requests.
sachin: Classic stampede. Does our SDK apply smoothing/backpressure on refresh path?
maria: SDK has exponential backoff for 429s but the token refresh code path bypasses the concurrency limiter. Also sampleapp spawns N workers w/o awaiting batches.
kevin: Can you paste the relevant snippet?
maria: ```js
// simplified prefetch loop in sampleapp
const docs = seedDocs()
for (const d of docs) {
  // currently firing off concurrently
  client.embed(d).then(store)
}
```
kevin: Oof. Two issues then: uncontrolled worker spawn + token refresh causing duplicate inflight retries.
maria: Proposed quick fixes: 1) limit prefetch concurrency in sampleapp (eg 6) 2) SDK: expose a config like `maxInflight` and `initialRampMs` so apps can ramp up 3) add a token-refresh mutex/join so only one refresh triggers retries.
uli: Agree. Also add jitter to the ramp so multiple clients don't align.
sachin: I can spin up a small PR for the sampleapp change (limit + ramp). Want me to include a tiny load test harness?
maria: Yes please — small harness with 50 simulated orgs would be ideal. I'll open the SDK issue for the API and mutex design.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-847: "client-side ramping & token-mutex for SDKs" — https://redwood/devex/847
ci-bot: sampleapp/pr-402 build passed :white_check_mark:
kevin: After PR merge let's run the 100-org sim with loadgen and validate 429s drop under 1%.
maria: PR merged to `devex/sampleapp` — prefetch concurrency set to 6 and added 1500ms ramp between batches. Local sim looked stable (0% 429s in 1k-query smoke).
kevin: Nice! Follow-up SDK issue will be important for long-term parity across languages.
uli: Filing SDK language parity checklist item: ensure Go/JS/Python expose the same `maxInflight` + `ramp` knobs.
sachin: I'll link the sampleapp PR to DEVEX-847 and add the loadgen results.
maria: Thanks all. We'll monitor signup wave tomorrow morning and roll back ramp if anything weird. :thumbsup:
